lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. Spatial distribution shows increasing inter-blob distance along the horizontal axis toward the right frame edge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like structure, most prominent in the central region of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear feature in the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-to-low vertical pixel intensity gradient running horizontally across the frame.
